name: XCC_REV_FUND_REQ_RULE_TARGETS
description: This table contains a record of each revenue funding rule and funding target account combination amounts derived by the create expense budget entry from revenue enterprise service scheduler process request. The create expense budget entry from revenue report displays the results of this process request using this data.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_REQUEST_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the process request, control budget and revenue funding rule.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_CCID
columns.description: Budget account combination code used for the budget entry.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percentage of the revenue source funding amount for the revenue funding rule  allocated to the target budget account.

columns.name: REVENUE_FUNDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget entry amount for the revenue funding rule and target budget account.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
